**BYLAWS OF THE COOPERATIVE**

Adopted by the Inaugural General Meeting held on 14 March 2015, and amended as indicated. These Bylaws are made pursuant to the Cooperative Societies Law of Kaduna State, 2004, and the Cooperative Societies Regulations, 2006.

---

**ARTICLE I: NAME, OBJECTS, AND REGISTERED OFFICE**

**1.1 Name.** The name of the Cooperative shall be Zazzau Tomato Growers and Marketing Cooperative Society Limited, hereinafter referred to as "the Cooperative."

**1.2 Objects.** The objects of the Cooperative shall be:
(a) To promote the economic interests of its members through the collective cultivation, harvesting, storage, and marketing of tomatoes and other horticultural produce.
(b) To provide inputs, credit, and technical assistance to members.
(c) To establish and operate storage, processing, and marketing facilities.
(d) To engage in such other lawful activities as may be conducive to the attainment of these objects.

**1.3 Registered Office.** The registered office of the Cooperative shall be located at the Cooperative Secretariat, Farm Plot 7, Zaria–Soba Road, Soba Local Government Area, Kaduna State. The address for correspondence shall be P.O. Box 412, Soba, Kaduna State.

---

**ARTICLE II: MEMBERSHIP**

**2.1 Eligibility.** Membership shall be open to any individual engaged in tomato farming or horticulture within the catchment area of the Cooperative, who:
(a) is at least eighteen (18) years of age;
(b) resides or farms within the Cooperative's area of operation;
(c) subscribes to the objects of the Cooperative;
(d) is of good character and not an undischarged bankrupt.

**2.2 Application.** Application for membership shall be made in writing on the prescribed form, accompanied by the admission fee and the minimum share subscription as determined by the Board of Directors from time to time.

**2.3 Admission.** Admission to membership shall be by resolution of the Board of Directors. The Board may, at its discretion, require an applicant to attend an orientation session or to provide evidence of farming activity.

**2.4 Share Capital.** Each member shall hold at least one (1) share of the Cooperative, of par value ₦1,000. No member shall hold more than one-fifth (1/5) of the total share capital of the Cooperative. Shares shall be non-transferable except with the approval of the Board.

**2.5 Register of Members.** The Secretary shall maintain a Register of Members containing the name, address, occupation, date of admission, shareholding, and such other particulars as the Board may determine. The Register shall be open for inspection by members during office hours.

**2.6 Cessation of Membership.** Membership shall cease upon:
(a) death;
(b) resignation in writing to the Secretary;
(c) expulsion under Article II, Section 2.8;
(d) cessation of the member's farming activity within the Cooperative's area of operation for a continuous period of two (2) years, unless excused by the Board.

**2.7 Withdrawal of Shares.** A member whose membership has ceased shall be entitled to a refund of the value of their shares, less any sums due to the Cooperative, within twelve (12) months of cessation.

**2.8 Expulsion.** A member may be expelled by a resolution of the Board of Directors passed at a meeting duly convened, provided that:
(a) the member has been given at least fourteen (14) days' written notice of the grounds of the proposed expulsion;
(b) the member has been afforded an opportunity to make representations to the Board;
(c) the expulsion is confirmed by a two-thirds (2/3) majority of the Board members present and voting;
(d) the expelled member may appeal to the General Meeting, whose decision shall be final.

---

**ARTICLE V — BOARD OF DIRECTORS**

**5.1 Composition.** The Board of Directors shall consist of not fewer than five (5) and not more than nine (9) members, elected at the Annual General Meeting for a term of three (3) years. The Board shall elect from among its members a Chairman, a Vice-Chairman, a Secretary, and a Treasurer.

**5.2 Meetings.** The Board shall meet at least once every quarter. A quorum shall be two-thirds (2/3) of the members of the Board. Decisions shall be by simple majority of those present and voting, except where these Bylaws provide otherwise.

**5.3 Powers.** The Board shall have the general management and control of the affairs of the Cooperative, including but not limited to:
(a) the power to admit or expel members in accordance with Article II;
(b) the power to invest funds of the Cooperative in such securities as may be approved by the General Meeting;
(c) the power to borrow money on behalf of the Cooperative, provided that the total outstanding borrowings shall not exceed fifty percent (50%) of the paid-up share capital without the prior approval of the General Meeting;
(d) the power to appoint and remove staff of the Cooperative;
(e) the power to enter into contracts for the purchase of inputs and the sale of produce.

**5.4 Duties of the Chairman.** The Chairman shall preside at all meetings of the General Meeting and the Board. In the absence of the Chairman, the Vice-Chairman shall preside.

**5.5 Duties of the Secretary.** The Secretary shall keep the minutes of all meetings, maintain the Register of Members, and be responsible for the correspondence of the Cooperative. The Secretary shall also prepare the Annual Return and file it with the Registrar of Cooperative Societies not later than 31 March of each year.

**5.6 Duties of the Treasurer.** The Treasurer shall be responsible for the custody of the funds of the Cooperative, the keeping of proper books of account, and the presentation of financial statements to the Board and the General Meeting.

**5.7 Vacancies.** A vacancy on the Board shall be filled by the Board by co-option, subject to confirmation at the next General Meeting. A Board member who is absent from three (3) consecutive meetings without reasonable cause shall be deemed to have vacated their seat.

---

**ARTICLE VI — GENERAL MEETINGS**

**6.1 Annual General Meeting.** The Cooperative shall hold an Annual General Meeting within three (3) months of the end of its financial year. The financial year shall end on 31 December.

**6.2 Extraordinary General Meeting.** An Extraordinary General Meeting may be called by the Board at any time, and shall be called upon the written request of at least one-tenth (1/10) of the members or upon the requisition of the Registrar.

**6.3 Notice.** At least fourteen (14) days’ written notice of any General Meeting shall be given to all members, specifying the business to be transacted. No other business shall be transacted at that meeting.

COOPERATIVE REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE AND BYLAWS
Kaduna Valley Tomato Growers Cooperative
Registration No.: KV/KN/COOP/2015/014
Issued under the Cooperative Societies Law of Kaduna State, Cap. C21, Laws of Kaduna State, 1991 (as amended)

This is to certify that the cooperative society known as KADUNA VALLEY TOMATO GROWERS COOPERATIVE (hereinafter referred to as "the Cooperative") has this day been duly registered under the provisions of the Cooperative Societies Law of Kaduna State, with all the rights, privileges, and obligations conferred by the said Law.

The registration document states that Kaduna Valley Tomato Growers Cooperative was founded_date 2015-03-14. Record status: current. This registration is current and remains in full force and effect, subject to the conditions and provisions of the Cooperative's bylaws and the aforementioned Law.

REGISTERED OFFICE:
No. 17, Ahmadu Bello Way, Kaduna Central Market, Kaduna State, Nigeria

REGISTERED MEMBERS AT FOUNDING: 47 (Forty-Seven)

OBJECTS OF THE COOPERATIVE:
1. To promote the economic interests of its members in accordance with cooperative principles.
2. To facilitate the production, collection, processing, and marketing of tomatoes grown by its members.
3. To arrange for the supply of inputs, including improved seedlings, fertilizers, pesticides, and irrigation equipment, to members at fair prices.
4. To provide credit facilities to members for agricultural purposes, subject to the availability of funds and the provisions of these bylaws.
5. To construct, operate, and maintain storage facilities, including cold storage, for the preservation of tomatoes.
6. To establish and operate processing units for the production of tomato paste, puree, and other tomato-derived products.
7. To assist members in obtaining loans, grants, or subsidies from government agencies, financial institutions, or other bodies.
8. To provide training and extension services to members on modern tomato farming techniques, post-harvest handling, and marketing.
9. To undertake such other activities as may be conducive to the attainment of the above objects.

MEMBERSHIP:
Membership shall be open to any person engaged in tomato farming within the Kaduna Valley area who is of good character and who subscribes to the objects of the Cooperative. Admission shall be by application to the Management Committee and shall be subject to the payment of the entrance fee and share capital contribution as prescribed in these bylaws.

MEMBERSHIP FEES AND SHARE CAPITAL:
- Entrance Fee: ₦500 (Five Hundred Naira) only, payable once at admission.
- Minimum Share Capital Contribution: ₦5,000 (Five Thousand Naira) per member, payable in installments as determined by the Management Committee.
- Maximum Shareholding: No single member shall hold more than 20% of the total paid-up share capital of the Cooperative.
- Shares shall not be transferable except with the approval of the Management Committee, and only to a person eligible for membership.

RIGHTS OF MEMBERS:
Each member shall have the right to:
a) Participate in the general meetings of the Cooperative and vote on all matters brought before such meetings.
b) Receive a share of the surplus (patronage refund) in proportion to their transactions with the Cooperative.
c) Access the services and facilities provided by the Cooperative, including training, inputs, and marketing support.
d) Inspect the books and records of the Cooperative, subject to reasonable notice and the provisions of the Law.
e) Be elected or appointed to any office or committee of the Cooperative, subject to the qualifications prescribed in these bylaws.

REGISTRATION OF COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES UNDER THE COOPERATIVES LAW, CAP. C11, LAWS OF KADUNA STATE, 2001

FORM CS-3: PARTICULARS OF LAND AND PREMISES

(To be completed in duplicate and submitted to the Registrar of Cooperatives alongside the application for registration.)

---

A. PARTICULARS OF COOPERATIVE

1. Name of Cooperative: Kaduna Valley Tomato Growers and Processors Cooperative Society Limited
2. Proposed Registration Number: KDS/COOP/2015/0117
3. Address of Registered Office: Plot 14, Ahmadu Bello Way, Zaria, Kaduna State

---

B. DESCRIPTION OF LAND AND PREMISES

The Cooperative hereby declares that it holds an interest in the land described below, which land shall be used for the purposes of the Cooperative's farming, storage, and processing activities.

1. **Land Registry Reference:** KDS/LR/ZA/2014/0876
2. **Location:** Farm Plot 7, Kaduna Valley Farm Settlement, along Zaria–Soba Road, approximately 14 kilometres east of Zaria town centre.
3. **Area:** The land registry lists Cooperative Farm Plot 7 area_hectares as 12.0 hectares. Record status: current. This is the current registered area as per the certificate of occupancy issued on 12 August 2014 and subsisting as at the date of this application.
4. **Encumbrances:** Nil. The land is free from any mortgage, charge, or other encumbrance.
5. **Use:** The land is currently used for the cultivation of tomatoes (predominantly the UC82B and Roma VF varieties) during the dry season under irrigation, with a portion reserved for the construction of a central collection shed and a small processing unit.
6. **Access:** The plot is accessible by a feeder road maintained by the Kaduna State Agricultural Development Project (KADP), which connects to the Zaria–Soba Road. The feeder road is passable by light trucks throughout the year, though during the peak of the rainy season (July–August) some sections may require grading.

---

C. SURVEY PLAN PARTICULARS

The land is shown on Survey Plan No. KDS/SV/2014/0452, prepared by Alhaji S. M. Danladi, Licensed Surveyor, dated 3 July 2014. The plan is deposited with the Office of the Surveyor-General of Kaduna State.

The boundaries of the plot are as follows:

- **North:** Bounded by an unnamed stream (seasonal tributary of River Galma), from beacon A to beacon B.
- **East:** Bounded by Farm Plot 8 (registered in the name of Sardauna Integrated Farms Ltd.) from beacon B to beacon C.
- **South:** Bounded by the Zaria–Soba Road right-of-way from beacon C to beacon D.
- **West:** Bounded by Farm Plot 6 (registered in the name of the Federal Ministry of Agriculture, Zaria Zonal Office) from beacon D to beacon A.

All boundary beacons are concrete pillars, 60 cm × 60 cm × 90 cm, painted white, and are in good condition as verified by the Cooperative's surveyor on 28 February 2015.

---

D. LAND USE ZONING AND PERMISSIONS

The plot falls within the Kaduna Valley Farm Settlement designated agricultural zone under the Kaduna State Town and Country Planning Law. No change of use permission is required for the Cooperative's proposed activities of tomato cultivation, storage, and small-scale processing.

The Cooperative has obtained:
1. Certificate of Occupancy No. KDS/C.O./2014/1128, dated 12 August 2014, issued by the Kaduna State Bureau for Land Administration.
2. Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) screening clearance from the Kaduna State Ministry of Environment, reference KDS/ENV/EIA/2015/003, dated 9 January 2015. The clearance confirms that the proposed activities do not require a full EIA study.

**COOPERATIVE REGISTRATION AND BYLAWS**

**ZAZZAU TOMATO GROWERS AND MARKETING COOPERATIVE SOCIETY LIMITED**
**Registration No. KDS/COOP/2014/0871**

**BYLAWS OF THE COOPERATIVE**

Adopted by the Inaugural General Meeting held on 14 March 2015, and amended as indicated. These Bylaws are made pursuant to the Cooperative Societies Law of Kaduna State, 2004, and the Cooperative Societies Regulations, 2006.

---

**ARTICLE I: NAME, OBJECTS, AND REGISTERED OFFICE**

**1.1 Name.** The name of the Cooperative shall be Zazzau Tomato Growers and Marketing Cooperative Society Limited, hereinafter referred to as "the Cooperative."

**1.2 Objects.** The objects of the Cooperative shall be:
(a) To promote the economic interests of its members through the collective cultivation, harvesting, storage, and marketing of tomatoes and other horticultural produce.
(b) To provide inputs, credit, and technical assistance to members.
(c) To establish and operate storage, processing, and marketing facilities.
(d) To engage in such other lawful activities as may be conducive to the attainment of these objects.

**1.3 Registered Office.** The registered office of the Cooperative shall be located at the Cooperative Secretariat, Farm Plot 7, Zaria–Soba Road, Soba Local Government Area, Kaduna State. The address for correspondence shall be P.O. Box 412, Soba, Kaduna State.

---

**ARTICLE II: MEMBERSHIP**

**2.1 Eligibility.** Membership shall be open to any individual engaged in tomato farming or horticulture within the catchment area of the Cooperative, who:
(a) is at least eighteen (18) years of age;
(b) resides or farms within the Cooperative's area of operation;
(c) subscribes to the objects of the Cooperative;
(d) is of good character and not an undischarged bankrupt.

**2.2 Application.** Application for membership shall be made in writing on the prescribed form, accompanied by the admission fee and the minimum share subscription as determined by the Board of Directors from time to time.

**2.3 Admission.** Admission to membership shall be by resolution of the Board of Directors. The Board may, at its discretion, require an applicant to attend an orientation session or to provide evidence of farming activity.

**2.4 Share Capital.** Each member shall hold at least one (1) share of the Cooperative, of par value ₦1,000. No member shall hold more than one-fifth (1/5) of the total share capital of the Cooperative. Shares shall be non-transferable except with the approval of the Board.

**2.5 Register of Members.** The Secretary shall maintain a Register of Members containing the name, address, occupation, date of admission, shareholding, and such other particulars as the Board may determine. The Register shall be open for inspection by members during office hours.

**2.6 Cessation of Membership.** Membership shall cease upon:
(a) death;
(b) resignation in writing to the Secretary;
(c) expulsion under Article II, Section 2.8;
(d) cessation of the member's farming activity within the Cooperative's area of operation for a continuous period of two (2) years, unless excused by the Board.

**2.7 Withdrawal of Shares.** A member whose membership has ceased shall be entitled to a refund of the value of their shares, less any sums due to the Cooperative, within twelve (12) months of cessation.

**2.8 Expulsion.** A member may be expelled by a resolution of the Board of Directors passed at a meeting duly convened, provided that:
(a) the member has been given at least fourteen (14) days' written notice of the grounds of the proposed expulsion;
(b) the member has been afforded an opportunity to make representations to the Board;
(c) the expulsion is confirmed by a two-thirds (2/3) majority of the Board members present and voting;
(d) the expelled member may appeal to the General Meeting, whose decision shall be final.

**COOPERATIVE REGISTRATION AND BYLAWS**

**Amendment No. 3 to the Bylaws of Kankara Farmers’ Multipurpose Cooperative Society Ltd**

**Registered under the Cooperative Societies Law, Cap C24, Laws of Katsina State, 1991**

**Date of Adoption:** 14 March 2015 (as amended 22 June 2017; 9 January 2020; 3 August 2022)

**Filed with:** The Katsina State Ministry of Agriculture and Natural Resources, Cooperative Division, on 14 March 2015. Amendments filed 5 July 2017, 20 February 2020, and 30 August 2022. Receipt numbers: KTS/COOP/2015/118, KTS/COOP/2017/094, KTS/COOP/2020/031, KTS/COOP/2022/207.

---

**ARTICLE V — BOARD OF DIRECTORS**

**5.1 Composition.** The Board of Directors shall consist of not fewer than five (5) and not more than nine (9) members, elected at the Annual General Meeting for a term of three (3) years. The Board shall elect from among its members a Chairman, a Vice-Chairman, a Secretary, and a Treasurer.

**5.2 Meetings.** The Board shall meet at least once every quarter. A quorum shall be two-thirds (2/3) of the members of the Board. Decisions shall be by simple majority of those present and voting, except where these Bylaws provide otherwise.

**5.3 Powers.** The Board shall have the general management and control of the affairs of the Cooperative, including but not limited to:
(a) the power to admit or expel members in accordance with Article II;
(b) the power to invest funds of the Cooperative in such securities as may be approved by the General Meeting;
(c) the power to borrow money on behalf of the Cooperative, provided that the total outstanding borrowings shall not exceed fifty percent (50%) of the paid-up share capital without the prior approval of the General Meeting;
(d) the power to appoint and remove staff of the Cooperative;
(e) the power to enter into contracts for the purchase of inputs and the sale of produce.

**5.4 Duties of the Chairman.** The Chairman shall preside at all meetings of the General Meeting and the Board. In the absence of the Chairman, the Vice-Chairman shall preside.

**5.5 Duties of the Secretary.** The Secretary shall keep the minutes of all meetings, maintain the Register of Members, and be responsible for the correspondence of the Cooperative. The Secretary shall also prepare the Annual Return and file it with the Registrar of Cooperative Societies not later than 31 March of each year.

**5.6 Duties of the Treasurer.** The Treasurer shall be responsible for the custody of the funds of the Cooperative, the keeping of proper books of account, and the presentation of financial statements to the Board and the General Meeting.

**5.7 Vacancies.** A vacancy on the Board shall be filled by the Board by co-option, subject to confirmation at the next General Meeting. A Board member who is absent from three (3) consecutive meetings without reasonable cause shall be deemed to have vacated their seat.

---

**ARTICLE VI — GENERAL MEETINGS**

**6.1 Annual General Meeting.** The Cooperative shall hold an Annual General Meeting within three (3) months of the end of its financial year. The financial year shall end on 31 December.

**6.2 Extraordinary General Meeting.** An Extraordinary General Meeting may be called by the Board at any time, and shall be called upon the written request of at least one-tenth (1/10) of the members or upon the requisition of the Registrar.

**6.3 Notice.** At least fourteen (14) days’ written notice of any General Meeting shall be given to all members, specifying the business to be transacted. No other business shall be transacted at that meeting.
